name: Higaki Akira
source: [url=/c19344]Saeko's[/url] childhood friend and the student council vice president. He is also the Archery Club's president. Akira is a very friendly guy who never shows any ill intent and who gets on good terms with [url=/c19333]Taichi[/url] right after he transfers in.
